label: Acclaimed knight
summary: The acclaimed knight of the accolade.
details: Works on an accolade and leads to the character who is its acclaimed knight.

label: Accolade
summary: The accolade that this character is the acclaimed knight of.
details: Works on a character. It goes the other way round from the acclaimed knight link, which leads from an accolade to its knight.

label: Accolade owner
summary: The character who owns the accolade.
details: Works on an accolade and leads to the character who owns it.

label: Accolade successor
summary: The successor of the accolade, as a character.
details: Works on an accolade. The game documents nothing more, and vanilla does not use it.

label: Accolade type
summary: The accolade type with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `accolade_type:key`. It works anywhere, with no scope needed. Vanilla uses it once.

label: Selected doctrine
summary: The doctrine the activity has selected at the given position.
details: Written `activity_doctrine:1`. Positions start at 1, not 0. Works on an activity. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Activity host
summary: The character who hosts the activity.
details: Works on an activity. Vanilla uses it very often.

label: Activity location
summary: The province where the activity currently takes place.
details: Works on an activity. It gives the current location.

label: Selected tenet
summary: The tenet the activity has selected at the given position.
details: Written `activity_tenet:1`. Positions start at 1, not 0. Works on an activity.

label: Activity type
summary: The type of the activity.
details: Works on an activity and leads to its activity type.

label: Activity type by key
summary: The activity type with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `activity_type:key`. It works anywhere, with no scope needed.

label: Administrative contract
summary: The character's vassal contract for the administrative province group of their ruler's government.
details: Works on a character, seen as the subject of a ruler. The game's documentation refers to the contract group `admin_province_contract`. Vanilla does not use it, so the details are taken from the game's documentation alone.

label: Administrative obligation level
summary: The current level of the `admin_province_contract` obligation, from the contract group of the ruler's government.
details: Works on a character and leads to an obligation level of a vassal contract. Vanilla does not use it, so the details are taken from the game's documentation alone.

label: Court position aptitude
summary: How well the character suits the given court position type, as a number.
details: Written `aptitude:court_position_key`. Works on a character. Vanilla uses it a lot.

label: Raw aptitude score
summary: The raw score of the character for the given court position type, as a number.
details: Written `aptitude_score:court_position_key`. Works on a character. The game's documentation calls it the raw score, in contrast to the plain aptitude link.

label: Army commander
summary: The character who commands the army.
details: Works on an army.

label: Army owner
summary: The character who owns the army.
details: Works on an army.

label: Array define value
summary: A number from one of the game's array defines.
details: Written `array_define:Namespace|Name|Index`. The index starts at 0. Works anywhere. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Artifact age
summary: The age of the artifact, as a number.
details: Works on an artifact. The game's documentation does not say in which unit the age is given.

label: Artifact owner
summary: The character who owns the artifact.
details: Works on an artifact.

label: Assigned tax slot
summary: The tax slot this character is assigned to pay into.
details: Works on a character. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Barony
summary: The de jure barony title of the title or province.
details: Works on a title or a province. De jure means the barony it belongs to by the map's title structure, not by who holds it.

label: Active holy site
summary: The active holy site attached to the barony.
details: Works on a title. A holy site is active when the county is controlled by the right faith and it has an enshrined holy relic. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Barony controller
summary: The character who controls the barony or province.
details: Works on a barony title or a province and leads to the character who controls it.

label: Betrothed
summary: The character the character is betrothed to.
details: Works on a character.

label: Dominant faith of culture
summary: The faith that is the most common in the culture, counted by counties.
details: Works on a culture. The game warns that this is an expensive calculation, so avoid using it often. A tie is decided by the order in which the faiths were defined.

label: Dominant religion of culture
summary: The religion that is the most common in the culture, counted by counties.
details: Works on a culture. The game warns that this is an expensive calculation, so avoid using it often. A tie is decided by the order in which the religions were defined.

label: Capital barony
summary: The barony title that is the capital of the character's realm.
details: Works on a character.

label: Capital county
summary: The county title of the character's realm capital.
details: Works on a character. The game's documentation words it as the de jure liege title of the capital county, which reads oddly. This description assumes it means the county of the capital; that is a reading of the game's documentation, not confirmed.

label: Capital province
summary: The province that is the capital of the character's realm.
details: Works on a character.

label: Capital vassal title
summary: The capital vassal title of the title.
details: Works on a title. The game's documentation does not explain what makes a vassal title the capital one.

label: Casus belli
summary: The casus belli (the reason for war) that the war was started with.
details: Works on a war.

label: Casus belli type
summary: The casus belli type with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `casus_belli_type:key`. It works anywhere, with no scope needed. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Challenger sponsor
summary: The sponsor title of a religious head challenger title.
details: Works on a title. The game's documentation names no more than this.

label: Historical character
summary: The historical (scripted) character with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `character:key`. It works anywhere, with no scope needed.

label: Participant group of character
summary: The participant group a given character belongs to in the situation sub-region.
details: Works on a situation sub-region, with the character written after the colon. Vanilla does not use it, so the form of the key follows the game's documentation only.

label: Claimant
summary: The claimant of the casus belli or war.
details: Works on a war or a casus belli.

label: Clerical elector title
summary: The clerical title the ruler holds, if they hold one.
details: Works on a character.

label: Clerical region
summary: The clerical region title that a county or barony lies in.
details: Works on a county or barony title.

label: Combat
summary: The combat that a combat side takes part in.
details: Works on a combat side.

label: Attacking side
summary: The attacking side of the combat.
details: Works on a combat.

label: Defending side
summary: The defending side of the combat.
details: Works on a combat.

label: War of the combat
summary: The war the combat is fought in.
details: Works on a combat.

label: Commanding army
summary: The army the character is commanding.
details: Works on a character.

label: Compare complex value
summary: A comparison that reads a value from a text you write after the colon.
details: The text must be something the game can parse, for example `scope:root.number_of(armies)`. It returns the value of that text where it is used. Vanilla does not use it, so the details come from the game's documentation alone.

label: Compare value
summary: A comparison that returns the value of what you give it, where it is used.
details: The documented example is `root.gold`. The game marks it as a wild card link. Vanilla does not use it, so the details come from the game's documentation alone.

label: Concubinist
summary: The concubinist of the character.
details: Works on a character. The game's documentation does not say in which direction the relation runs (who keeps whom as a concubine).

label: Confederation
summary: The confederation the character belongs to.
details: Works on a character.

label: Confederation type
summary: The type of the confederation.
details: Works on a confederation. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Confederation type by key
summary: The confederation type with the key you write after the colon.
details: Written `confederation_type:key`. It works anywhere, with no scope needed. Vanilla does not use it.
